source.note: Official main commit 8c80bab3 (Prologue PR #146, tree 4fd58be62d4fa6979e8e08243dc7a11f13592548, on top of PR #142 96d2ee91, PR #143 18838190, PR #144 9859b93f, PR #145 69f05e12): KV-cache / two-zone system prompt / attachment anchor / microCompaction stepTurns=4 primitives (#142-#144), settled network call & idle session lifecycle retention fixes (#145-#146), fail-closed stream tool-call truncation under max-tokens, ProtocolCapabilities.promptIncludesCache & UsageReceipt.promptIncludesCache, cacheSafeFork same-root/read-only enforcement, and 0.1.0-rc.4 release bump. No vendor patch.

steps: Extract two independent clean archives from official main commit 8c80bab37a8c63c3a4bd461c7e67b413322b3179 (Prologue PR #146) via git archive.
Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts, pnpm build, and pnpm -C packages/sdk pack in both clean archives using Node 24.15.0 and pnpm 11.9.0.
Confirm both produced prologue-sdk-0.1.0-rc.4.tgz tarballs are byte-identical via cmp -s and record exact bytes, SHA-256, and SHA-512 integrity.
build.note: Official 0.1.0-rc.4 package verified by full local pnpm quality (440/440 SDK Vitest files / 5,547 tests, clean-consumer, Rust fmt/clippy/test 117/117). GitHub Actions run 46105289409 did not start steps due to account billing/spending limit.
